From b2f3a481c4cd62f78391b836b64c0a6e72b503d2 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Jose Abreu <Jose.Abreu@synopsys.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Dec 2019 11:17:42 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] net: stmmac: Enable 16KB buffer size

XGMAC supports maximum MTU that can go to 16KB. Lets add this check in
the calculation of RX buffer size.

Fixes: 7ac6653a085b ("stmmac: Move the STMicroelectronics driver")
Signed-off-by: Jose Abreu <Jose.Abreu@synopsys.com>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>

diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/stmicro/stmmac/stmmac_main.c b/drivers/net/ethernet/stmicro/stmmac/stmmac_main.c
index f507a9bee15b..1cb466dd5b3f 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/stmicro/stmmac/stmmac_main.c
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/stmicro/stmmac/stmmac_main.c
@@ -1109,7 +1109,9 @@ static int stmmac_set_bfsize(int mtu, int bufsize)
 {
 	int ret = bufsize;
 
-	if (mtu >= BUF_SIZE_4KiB)
+	if (mtu >= BUF_SIZE_8KiB)
+		ret = BUF_SIZE_16KiB;
+	else if (mtu >= BUF_SIZE_4KiB)
 		ret = BUF_SIZE_8KiB;
 	else if (mtu >= BUF_SIZE_2KiB)
 		ret = BUF_SIZE_4KiB;
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/net/ethernet/stmicro/stmmac/stmmac_main.c`**
- The function `stmmac_set_bfsize` has been modified to accommodate a maximum MTU of 16KB.
- The condition checking for the MTU has been updated:
  - The first condition now checks if `mtu >= BUF_SIZE_8KiB`, and if true, sets `ret` to `BUF_SIZE_16KiB`.
  - The second condition checks if `mtu >= BUF_SIZE_4KiB`, and if true, sets `ret` to `BUF_SIZE_8KiB`.
- This change allows the RX buffer size to be set to 16KB when the MTU is sufficiently large.

### Relationships
- The modification in `stmmac_main.c` directly addresses a limitation in the RX buffer size calculation related to the maximum MTU supported by XGMAC, which is now correctly set to allow for 16KB buffers.
- This patch fixes a previous issue introduced by commit `7ac6653a085b`, which did not account for the 16KB buffer size, thereby enhancing the functionality of the STMicroelectronics driver.

Here is the commit message:
net: stmmac: Enable 16KB buffer size

XGMAC supports maximum MTU that can go to 16KB. Lets add this check in
the calculation of RX buffer size.

Fixes: 7ac6653a085b ("stmmac: Move the STMicroelectronics driver")
Signed-off-by: Jose Abreu <Jose.Abreu@synopsys.com>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the absence of a condition in the RX buffer size calculation for supporting the maximum MTU of 16KB, which resulted in incorrect buffer size settings when larger MTUs were used, potentially leading to performance issues or packet loss.

Here is the patch:
 
 static int stmmac_set_bfsize(int mtu, int bufsize)
 {
 	int ret = bufsize;
 
-	if (mtu >= BUF_SIZE_4KiB)
+	if (mtu >= BUF_SIZE_8KiB)
+		ret = BUF_SIZE_16KiB;
+	else if (mtu >= BUF_SIZE_4KiB)
 		ret = BUF_SIZE_8KiB;
 	else if (mtu >= BUF_SIZE_2KiB)
 		ret = BUF_SIZE_4KiB;
 	else if (mtu > DEFAULT_BUFSIZE)
 		ret = BUF_SIZE_2KiB;
 	else
 		ret = DEFAULT_BUFSIZE;
 
 	return ret;
 }
